[SWS_CryIf_00114] CryIf_KeyElementCopy API: Forward key job to the mapped
driver in case of cryIfKeyId and targetCryIfKeyId are located in the different
Crypto Driver
Upstream requirements: SRS_CryptoStack_00104
⌈If no errors are detected by CRYIF and the cryIfKeyId and targetCryIfKeyId are lo-
cated in different Crypto Drivers, the service CryIf_KeyElementCopy shall copy the
provided key element by getting the element with Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_KeyElementGet
and setting the target key element via Crypto_<vi>_<ai>_KeyElementSet.⌋
